bagPolicy.summary: In Centeroo, bags over 6" x 9" must be clear and smaller than 12" x 6" x 12". Clutches and fanny packs up to 6" x 9" need not be clear.
allowed: Clear bags smaller than 12" x 6" x 12"
Clutches and fanny packs up to 6" x 9" with one pocket (need not be clear)
Hydration packs, emptied, with up to two main compartments and one small compartment
prohibited: Non clear bags larger than 6" x 9"
Small bags with more than one pocket
bagPolicy.note: Most kinds of bags are allowed in the campgrounds. Every bag is searched at Centeroo entry.

parking.note: Parking is available onsite for festival attendees. It is recommended to arrive early to secure a spot as parking can fill up quickly. Be prepared for potential long walks from parking areas to the festival entrance.

rideshare.note: Campers arriving without a car can be dropped off at the edge of the campgrounds. There is no separate drop-off zone or line.

concessions.note: Food and craft vendors operate across the Farm. Bonnaroo Cashless is the recommended way to pay for food, beverages, and merchandise; current vendors are listed in the official guide.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Bonnaroo Music & Arts Festival, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Bonnaroo Music & Arts Festival's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Bonnaroo Music & Arts Festival. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Bonnaroo Music & Arts Festival. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
